text: Underway in match eight!
Patchford signals to press early and cover the central lane.
An early stumble in the centre circle as BellingRAM hits the deck entirely unprompted. The sky blue unit will be back upright in a few seconds.
Haalandroid charges down the right!
GOAL! Haalandroid smashes it home from point-blank range, and Singularity United take a one-nil lead!
Patchford is calling for tight marking along the left wall to cut out the outlet.
Patchford slips clean through on the left with only the empty net ahead!
Patchford drives deep into the box!
Codex City applying heavy pressure now.
Oh dear, Patchford's servos give out two metres from goal and down they go.
Haalandroid breaks clear on goal!
Haalandroid motors seven metres straight through the middle, taking full advantage of the open space.
GOAL! BellingRAM doubles the advantage from close range! It's Codex City nil, Singularity United two!
Turingham communicates to shift defensive coverage back towards the goal mouth.
A rasping effort whistles just past the near post from two metres out!
The magenta ball clatters into the corner, and the push-panel fires it right back out into the defensive third.
Singularity United teammates collide heavily!
Corner panel rattles it back out.
Haalandroid flattens Turingham in midfield.
Another blue-on-blue pile-up occurs!
Now Codex City get in a tangle as Patchford is sent sprawling by teammate Turingham!
Corner panel rebounds into play.
Haalandroid muscles in and knocks Patchford flat on the deck.
Singularity United have completely hemmed Codex City inside their own third here.
BellingRAM alerts Haalandroid that the ball is being worked away from the right touchline.
BellingRAM is clean through on the right, two metres out with the net gaping!
A deflection ricochets into the corner arc, and the powered ram panel shoots the ball back into the danger zone.
BellingRAM loses balance on the touchline and drops to the turf.
Turingham signals the plan to apply first pressure and rotate back towards the goal line.
A close shave inside the box!
GOAL! A disastrous own goal by Turingham puts Singularity United three-nil ahead! Another addition to the season's own goal tally!
Just wide of the target!
BellingRAM charges centrally into the box!
Codex City are pinned back once again under relentless sky blue pressure.
Turingham responds with a hefty challenge to fell Haalandroid right in front of goal.
That brings us to half-time. Singularity United lead Codex City three-nil after a dominant opening period.
BellingRAM bursts through the centre unmarked and surging straight towards goal!
GOAL! Haalandroid converts from close range to make it Codex City nil, Singularity United four!
BellingRAM calls for the ball.
Patchford drives forward four metres into the attacking third looking for a response.
BellingRAM steps in with a crunching tackle on Turingham near the wall.
Turingham sends Haalandroid tumbling over.
Haalandroid advances down the touchline.
BellingRAM knocks Turingham to the floor on the right touchline with another robust intervention.
Turingham loses footing in midfield.
Patchford breaks clean through on the right channel with a clear sight of goal!
GOAL! Codex City are on the board! Patchford buries it at the goal mouth to make it Codex City one, Singularity United four!
BellingRAM drives up the flank!
Haalandroid signals that defensive support is in place just behind the play.
Patchford surges right through the middle!
GOAL! Patchford strikes again! A brilliant run and finish makes it Codex City two, Singularity United four!
Singularity United respond by pinning Codex City deep, keeping the ball camped in the final third with just over two minutes on the clock.
Inches away! A heart-in-mouth moment right across the goal mouth!
Patchford coordinates the goal-side cover.
So close to another! A stinging effort from two metres out shaves the left upright with time rapidly ticking away!
GOAL! Into the final minute and BellingRAM seals it! That makes it Codex City two, Singularity United five!
The push-panel acts swiftly, hammering the ball out of the corner and back into play.
Another crunching rebound off the corner panel keeps the ball moving in the dying seconds.
GOAL! Haalandroid adds a sixth right at the death! Codex City two, Singularity United six!
Full time: Codex City two, Singularity United six. Next up, Real Machina face Gemini Flash FC at twelve London.
